_meta.author: Phase 2 — ComputaForm Data Dictionary Validation & Schema Engineering
_meta.phase: READ-ONLY AUDIT — DO NOT USE FOR ML TRAINING YET
_meta.note: All fields preserve raw_value alongside normalized_value. Leakage classifications are conservative by design.

Race.description: Meeting-level and race-level metadata extracted from the ComputaForm overview pages.

fields.description: Sequential race number within the meeting. Extracted from the page header line 'RACE N VAAL ...'.
Name of the racecourse / meeting venue. Extracted from overview page heading.

fields.source_label: TURF / POLYTRACK / DIRT / SAND (first-page surface marker)
fields.description: Racing surface type. Appears as first line of a race detail page.
Race distance in metres. Appears in the race page header line.
Scheduled start time of the race.
Prize money / stake for this race in South African Rand.

fields.source_label: REF: 9 (race reference code in page header)
fields.description: Internal ComputaForm race reference / class code. Appears in page header as 'REF: N'.

fields.source_label: Bipot Leg N / Jackpot Leg N / Pick 6 Leg N / Place Accumulator Leg N
fields.description: Exotic betting pool leg designation for this race.
Race class descriptor e.g. 'Mr84C', 'MiddB', 'MdnP'. Per historical table row.
Date of the meeting in the page header (e.g. '06 08 2026').

Horse.description: Per-runner bio card data extracted from the ComputaForm runner block. All values are pre-race.

fields.description: Horse name as it appears in the ComputaForm PDF (title-cased during normalization).

fields.source_label: N (draw number left of horse name)
fields.description: Saddle/cloth number as printed on the ComputaForm.
Barrier/starting stall draw position.

fields.source_label: 7 B g (age sex colour on bio line 2)
fields.description: Horse age in years extracted from the second bio line.
Horse coat colour abbreviation (B=Bay, Ch=Chestnut, Gr=Grey, Ro=Roan, Bl=Black).
Horse sex: g=gelding, f=filly, m=mare, c=colt, h=horse.

fields.source_label: Futura - Archerfield (USA) by Arch (USA) (sire/dam pedigree line)
fields.description: Sire name. The first name before ' - ' on the pedigree line.
Dam (mother) name. Between ' - ' and ' by ' on the pedigree line.
Broodmare sire. Appears after ' by ' on the pedigree line.
Horse date of birth.
Date the horse was gelded.

fields.source_label: M N Houdalakis (V) (trainer line before LIFE stats)
fields.description: Trainer name. 3rd or 4th line of the bio block, before LIFE stats. NOT YET EXTRACTED.
fields.note: Currently returns Unknown. Line position disambiguation needed.

fields.description: Jockey name assigned to ride this horse.
True if the jockey is an apprentice (name prefixed with '*' in the PDF).
Horse owner(s). Appears after 'OWNER/S:' on the bio info line.

example.raw_value: Drakenstein Stud (Nom: Mrs G A Rupert)

fields.description: Horse breeder name. Appears after 'BRED BY:' on the bio info line.

fields.source_label: R140,000 A2YS21 (purchase price in info line)
fields.description: Price paid at auction. Appears with sale catalogue code.
Allocated carry weight in kilograms.
fields.extraction_pattern: KGs label + following decimal number token

fields.source_label: A / B / C (headgear code before CF Rate label)
fields.description: Headgear code (B=Blinkers, C=Cheekpieces, H=Hood, V=Visor). Exact mapping needs verification.
fields.extraction_pattern: Single letter token before CF Rate Headgear label

fields.description: Shoe type indicator. Full value not yet parsed.
Current Merit Rating for today's race. Primary handicap input.
ComputaForm internal house rating. 'A 46' tokens = grade letter + rate number.
fields.extraction_pattern: Value token after CF Rate Headgear label

fields.description: ComputaForm F/B forecast odds in fractional notation.
F/B odds converted to European decimal. Formula: num/den + 1.
Total career race starts. First number in the LIFE stats tuple.
Total career wins.
Total career second-place finishes.
Total career third-place finishes.
Total career prize money earned.
Current season runs-wins-seconds-thirds-unplaced.
Runs-wins record of this specific jockey on this specific horse.
Runs-wins record of this jockey-trainer partnership.
Career record on Turf surface.
Career record at this specific racecourse.
Career record on Good going.
Career record on Wet/Soft/Heavy going.
Career record at today's race distance.
Career record at this course AND today's distance.
Career record when wearing headgear.
Career record for the broad distance category (Sprint/Mile/Middle/Stayer).
Career record when the horse had 14+ days rest before a start.
Career record in the same race class.
Best Weight-Performance Rating and associated distance. Formula unconfirmed.
Difference between horse's best speed rating and its average. Positive = peak exceeds average.
Speed Rating from most recent run.
Recent Rating (RR) — short-term form rating.

fields.source_label: N Days Since Last Race (info line)
fields.description: Days since the horse's previous race start.

fields.source_label: N Days Since Last Win (info line)
fields.description: Days since the horse's last winning run.

HistoricalRace.description: Each historical past-performance row for a horse. These describe COMPLETED races — all safe as HISTORICAL features.
HistoricalRace.note: Do NOT confuse with today's race. All fields here are from the horse's past.

fields.description: Date of the historical race.
3-letter venue code (VAC=Vaal, TUR=Turffontein, TFI=Turffontein Inner, KEN=Kenilworth).

fields.source_label: G (going column: G=Good S=Soft H=Heavy F=Firm)
fields.description: Going/track condition for the historical race.
Internal ComputaForm race reference number.
Race class code for the historical race.
Prize money in thousands ZAR for the historical race.
Ability Rating assigned after the historical race.
Race distance for the historical race. R suffix = Rail position indicator.

fields.source_label: A (field size grade in historical table)
fields.description: Field size grade letter. Exact mapping requires verification.
Merit Rating carried by the horse in the historical race.
fields.extraction_pattern: MR Jockey column integer before jockey name

fields.description: Jockey who rode the horse in the historical race.
Weight carried in the historical race.
Barrier draw in the historical race.
Number of runners in the historical race.
Opening board price for the historical race.
Official Starting Price for the historical race.
Position in lengths behind leader at the 800m point.
Position in lengths behind leader at the 400m point.
Finishing position in the historical race.
Margin of defeat in lengths behind winner.
Name of the winner.
Weight carried by the winner in the historical race.
Winning time of the historical race in seconds.
Final 400m sectional time for the race.
Rail position in metres on the day of the historical race.
Handicap average value. Exact meaning unconfirmed.
Adjusted time per metre — normalised speed figure for cross-distance comparison.
ComputaForm speed rating for the historical race.
Combined weight-rating code. Exact interpretation unconfirmed.
